ev.q: From 1996 to 2009, C. difficile rates for hospitalized persons aged ≥65 years increased 200%
The figure shows rates of Clostridium difficile infection among hospitalized patients aged ≥65 years
C. difficile rates among patients aged ≥85 years were notably higher than those for the other age groups
with increases of 175% for those aged 65--74 years, 198% for those aged 75--84 years
SOURCE: National Hospital Discharge Survey, Annual Files, 1996--2009
From 1996 to 2009, C. difficile rates for hospitalized persons aged ≥65 years increased 200%

methods_quotes.q: Rates for 1996--1999 were based on U.S. Census Bureau civilian population estimates adjusted for the net underenumeration in the 1990 census.
Rates for 2000--2009 were calculated using U.S. Census Bureau 2000-based postcensal civilian population estimates.
